title: Alchemy of Personal Transformation
author: Unknown
description: The Emerald Tablet: Alchemy of Personal Transformation by Dennis William Hauck (Penguin/Arkana, 1999), a modern guide by a leading writer on practical alchemy. It takes the Emerald Tablet of Hermes Trismegistus, the short cryptic text ('as above, so below') that served as the charter of Western alchemy, and explains its history, from legends of its discovery in the tomb of Hermes and its Arabic sources to its influence on medieval and Renaissance adepts. Part 1 unpacks the tablet line by line and its symbolism. Part 2 applies the 'Emerald Formula' as a sequence of operations (calcination, dissolution, separation, conjunction, fermentation, distillation and coagulation) to psychological and spiritual growth, with exercises and meditations. Part 3 considers what the tablet suggests about humanity's future. The book links laboratory alchemy, Jungian psychology and Hermetic philosophy into a programme of inner transformation.
